author.bio: Solution Architect, Problem Solver, Applied Researcher, and Educator
author.about: I operate at the intersection of computer science theory and production engineering. Rather than treating languages or tech stacks as identities, I treat them as tools: whether reasoning about distributed consensus, formal verification, or compiler optimizations, the core challenge is always correctness, invariants, and performance under stress. My approach combines the rigor of an applied researcher with the velocity and pragmatism of a startup builder—taking novel mathematical concepts from whiteboard design to mission-critical systems deployed across dozens of networks. Please see my full [professional CV](/assets/documents/sbjoshi_full_professional.pdf) and [academic CV](/assets/documents/sbjoshi_full_academic.pdf) for details.
